articles.title: Bitcoin slips under $80K after US PPI gains most in four years
articles.snippet: BTC buyers attempted to defend $80,000 support after September US producer inflation overshot expectations by 100 basis points for the largest monthly gain since March 2022

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs shed $261M as XRP funds buck weekly outflow trend
articles.snippet: Bitcoin ETFs have recorded $151 million in net outflows since Monday, after investors withdrew $681 million the previous week.
